rules.standard: Choose one eligible category uniformly for the Uncommon+ slot; other slots use the base rarity pool. Only available eligible rarities are weighted; choose parts uniformly within the selected rarity.
rules.reclaimed: If unowned eligible parts remain, choose a category uniformly among categories with unowned parts, then use base rarity weights conditioned on its unowned pool. Another eligible category supplies Uncommon+. All other slots use base weights. Complete collections use standard rules.
rules.missing_rarity: Exclude unavailable rarities and normalize remaining positive weights. Missing component categories or impossible guarantees refuse purchase.
